input.title: Partner introduction call
input.summary: Dana Brooks introduced work across two companies, Cedar Ridge Software and Ironwood Manufacturing. Luis Ferreira described Ironwood as the larger reporting problem and Cedar Ridge as the one with a deadline. The group agreed to scope Cedar Ridge Software first and return to Ironwood in January.
decisions: Scope Cedar Ridge Software first; come back to Ironwood in January.

actionItems.task: Send a scoping questionnaire for Cedar Ridge Software
actionItems.quote: I'll send a short scoping questionnaire for Cedar Ridge Software tomorrow.

actionItems.task: Pull the current CRM export from Ironwood Manufacturing
actionItems.quote: I'll pull the current CRM export from Ironwood Manufacturing so you can see the size of it.

followUp.subject: Introduction call: next steps
followUp.body:
Hi Dana and Luis,

Thanks for the introduction. We agreed to scope Cedar Ridge Software first and to come back to Ironwood in January.

I will send a short scoping questionnaire tomorrow. Luis, the CRM export from Ironwood will help us size that work.

Best,
Casey
